notes: पहुँचना is an intransitive verb used to indicate arrival at a physical place or attainment of a goal.
It typically takes the postposition पर (on/at) or तक (up to) with the destination.

senses.definition: To arrive at or get to a destination or place.

examples.text: हम समय पर स्टेशन पहुँच गए।
examples.translation: We reached the station on time.
examples.emotion: relieved and unhurried, glad to make it without rushing

senses.definition: To attain a certain level, age, or state.

examples.text: वह सफलता के शिखर पर पहुँच गया।
examples.translation: He reached the peak of success.
examples.emotion: proud and triumphant, looking back at the journey
